hold close on Chico lying across her feet, chin on her toes, ONE eye open and sleepy, looking toward the camera, the other eye closed, MACA's soft chest glow behind him

plan.continuity: Maria asleep in the bed on the screen-left under the grey knit blanket, head on the pillow; MACA seated at the bedside on the screen-right with her chest light glowing softly; Chico, the only dog in the room, on the bed across Maria's feet at the foot end of the blanket
preventions: Chico flops across Maria's FEET at the foot of the bed and never on her chest, shoulder, face or pillow
Chico ends with ONE eye open and the other eye closed, never both shut and never both wide open
one Chico only: no second dog, nothing on the floor or the rug, and he stays on the bed once he is up
Maria stays asleep in the bed and does not wake
the room, the bed, the toy chest and the blanket do not change
MACA's helmet stays a clean smooth round white shell with one round ear disc on each side and nothing attached: no fins, wings, rays, lines, spikes or antennae near her head or ears

design: Replaces V22 f169-f336. The accepted shots keep Chico jumping from the star chest onto the foot of the bed (f139-f168). The defect is the wide f169-f252, where he walks up and lies at her chest and hip, then the macro f253-f336 whose eyes close before the line 'one eye open' (take f318-f337). 7 s = 168 frames ends exactly on the take's last used frame (f336), so the last pin is a new keyframe, K_R6_A2_END, (macro, one eye open). Cheaper variant (not specced): 4 s from V22 f168 to V22 f264 (frames of the take) leaves the closed-eye ending.
